title: MissionNav2ThroughPoses
description: One nav2 NavigateThroughPoses mission's lifecycle: a mission_start Record when the goal is first observed, a mission_end Record once it reaches a terminal state. Shares #387's NavigateToPose Record contract; mission_type distinguishes the source action

mission_type.description: What kind of mission this was; the nav2 adapter always sets 'navigate_through_poses'

recoveries.description: NavigateThroughPoses::Feedback.number_of_recoveries at mission completion, when feedback was seen
